title: Qualification evidence
summary: WebSocket dev1 passed its RFC 6455 contract suite under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and completed a live loopback exchange against the independent Python websockets implementation through the SocketProvider isolation seam.
invariants: Contract evidence includes the RFC 6455 example handshake accept calculation and masking vector.
Live COTS evidence used an independent Python websockets server, not a WebSocket implementation from the same package.
The live path exercised WebSocketAccess -> SocketProvider -> RxSock TCP -> independent RFC 6455 peer -> WebSocketMessage.
SocketAddress identity survives the isolation seam as an object.
The 2026-10-13 transport grid carries this as inherited COTS evidence in the dev16 estate; it explicitly does not claim a fresh dev16 live rerun.
